thread:
Elaine: Quick prelaunch SEO check — webinar landing + post page mapping. Need redirects, schema, internal linking from resources hub, and benchmark narrative alignment. Any blockers?
Priya: I can take redirects + canonical audit. Will run a crawl and deliver a CSV map by EOD Mon. Prefer 301s for permanent moves?
Sam: 301s for public redirects. If we run experiments, use 302 temporarily. Also preserve UTM params in rewrites.
Jackson: I can own JSON-LD for Event/FAQ/VideoObject. Will draft examples — need startDate + duration + host fields.
Priya: Running Screaming Frog + a site: crawl now. Will flag redirect chains and depth >3 pages for the seed content.
Elaine: Great. Keyword focus for the webinar/post: 'LLM inference latency', 'reduce inference cost', 'production LLM serving' — prioritize long-tail variants for blog copy.
Sam: I'll update H1/H2 and meta desc to match those keywords. Proposed H1: "Scaling LLM Inference: Webinar & Benchmarks" — concise and covers intent.
Priya: Redirect snippet for nginx (param-preserving):
```rewrite ^/old-demo/(.*)$ /webinar-demo/$1?utm_source=$arg_utm_source permanent;```
Also note: avoid redirect chains >1 hop. I'll list any chains I find.
SEO_Bot: Crawl report ready — 48 URLs missing canonical, 12 redirect chains, 3 pages disallowed by robots. Report ID cr-2026-04-12.
Jackson: JSON-LD skeleton (will push to PR for the page head):
```{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Event",
  "name": "Scaling LLM Inference: Live Webinar",
  "startDate": "2026-04-28T17:00:00Z",
  "location": "Online",
  "description": "Redwood Inference — production tips and benchmark narratives on latency & cost."
}```
Elaine: Action owners: Priya = redirects & canonical audit, Jackson = schema & structured data, Sam = on-page copy + H1/H2/meta, Elaine = benchmark narrative + post-launch checklist. Deliverables: crawl CSV, redirect map, JSON-LD snippets, updated meta copy by Mon EOD.
Sam: I'll add the H1/H2 changes to the content doc and link the PR here when ready.
Priya: If anyone sees legacy demo pages under /demos or /beta, ping me — those are high-risk for duplicate content.
Elaine: Cool. If Priya finds redirect chains we can't fix before launch, we'll do canonical hints on the interim pages and schedule a quick rollback test. Ping here with blockers. :rocket:
